messages:
alex: FYI partner engineer hit consistent quant-kernel OOMs in nightly canary on Ampere (CUDA12.2 + driver 525.x). They flagged it as 'repro rate ~80%'.

maria: ugh, thanks for the heads up. which marketplace image + driver did they run?

alex: repo + image: redwood/mkt-cuda12-quant:canary (sha: e3f2c1). driver reported 525.89. test harness: microbench + full-endpoint smoke. Link to partner gist: https://gist.github.com/partner/quant-ooms

jamal: can we get logs + nvml output? sounds like a kernel mem leak/regression vs packing path. if it's 80% reproducible we should do a joint night sprint with partner and SI.

chris: adding context from ML side: recent attention-kernel changes change peak kv memory patterns — we saw small footprint increases in long-seq profiles. might interact badly with quantized kernels on CUDA12.2.

natalie: marketplace implications: if partner wants a hotfix pin we need a plan. We can't update the marketplace image without passing canaries for other regions. propose: nightly regression sprint -> hotfix candidate build -> gated canary in eu-west -> hold public announcement until post-rollout.

alex: proposed immediate plan: 1) schedule 0100-0500 UTC regression sprint with partner (+SI) tonight; 2) eng-runtime to run targeted reproducer with driver 525.89 and fallback 520.x; 3) build a canary image with quant-opt disabled as short-term workaround; 4) if reproduces, cut hotfix branch and coordinate marketplace pin + comms.

maria: I can own partner comms and logistics. @jamal can you confirm runtime folks are available? @natalie can you prep marketplace holdback checklist?

jamal: I can get a couple folks. @chris can you prepare the reproducer script and a minimized dataset? also, post the exact nvprof/nvml commands we should run.

chris: repro script snippet:
```
# run on a canary node with driver 525.89
./repro_runner.sh --image redwood/mkt-cuda12-quant:canary --model tiny-quant --seq 4096 --batch 4 --iters 50 --collect-nvml /tmp/nvml.out
# nvml snapshot
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -lms 200 > /tmp/gpu.csv &
python collect_kvstats.py --out kv_stats.json
```

jamal: perfect. runtime note: add env var REDWOOD_QUANT_KERNS=0 to disable the quant kernel path for testing. that'll validate whether fallback avoids OOM.

driver-bot: CI job nightly-canary (image: redwood/mkt-cuda12-quant:canary) failed 3/5 tests — see https://ci.redwood.ai/job/12345/console 

alex: good catch @driver-bot. that aligns with partner signal. Maria — can you confirm partner can join 0100 UTC? If not, we push to 0300.

maria: partner confirmed 0100 UTC. SI says they can do 0200-0400 UTC overlap. I'll send calendar invite and the zoom link.

natalie: marketplace holdback checklist draft: 
- freeze image tag updates for canary -> hold until hotfix validated
- mark regions eu-west/us-west as canary lanes
- block public release announcement until rollback window closes
I'll drop the checklist doc after sprint.

jamal: operational playbook if OOM confirmed: 
- increment hotfix branch: r-infer/patch/quant-kern-525
- include two fixes: disable quant-opt by default + small kv cache cap fallback
- run full regression matrix (short + long seq) in dedicated pool (4x nodes)
- create rollback image tag if regression introduced elsewhere

chris: risk note: disabling quant-opt reduces throughput ~12% on some gpus. need to make that trade visible to partner and docs.

alex: comms plan: partner announcement (internal) after hotfix cut; public marketplace announcement only after canary pass + one-day observation.

maria: sending invites now. adding meeting agenda and repro links. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9999999999 Passcode: stack

jamal: I'll be online at 2345 UTC to prep nodes and driver switcher. @driver-bot can you queue a pair of canary nodes with driver 525.89 and a fallback pool with 520.61?

driver-bot: Queued nodes: canary-nodes-03 (driver 525.89), fallback-nodes-07 (driver 520.61). ETA: 12 minutes.

alex: thanks all — let's treat this as high-priority but keep comms short in this channel. after the sprint we'll post a brief postmortem + recommended marketplace action. :thumbsup:

maria: noted. will capture notes and partner ack.

chris: if we find a kernel bug, recommend opening partner escalations with vendor and include kernel dumps (minidumps) + repro steps.

jamal: agreed. i'll prepare the gating checklist for cutting the hotfix image.

alex: last q — do we want to pre-authorize a rollback image tag so marketplace teams can flip if things regress?

maria: yes, pre-authorize rollback tag r-infer/rollback/quant-525-2026-03-21. I'll loop in legal/comms if public messaging needed.

alex: ok locking that in. see you tonight.

(END)
